findings.evidence: Geometry.SimplicialComplex extends PreAbstractSimplicialComplex E (mathlib/.../Analysis/Convex/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:60); faces/isRelLowerSet_faces originate in PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (mathlib/.../AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean:47-52). No occurrence of 𝕜, indep, inter_subset_convexHull, or convexHull in the diff body.
findings.fix: Restate the file over PreAbstractSimplicialComplex E (or AbstractSimplicialComplex E) from Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Basic.lean, dropping the 𝕜/Field/Module/IsStrictOrderedRing variables; keep only the [LinearOrder E] [DecidableEq E] actually needed for the order-hom simplices.
findings.issue: Every definition (eulerChar, genusOfComplex, simplicialSetOfComplex*, SimplicialMap, homologyGroup, deg) takes K : Geometry.SimplicialComplex 𝕜 E and carries [Field 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 E] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] etc., but only ever uses K.faces and K.isRelLowerSet_faces — the fields of PreAbstractSimplicialComplex E. The geometric layer (indep, inter_subset_convexHull, convexHull) and all of 𝕜/Field/Module are unused dead weight, so the existing abstract-complex API is not reused and applicability is needlessly narrowed to geometric complexes.

summary: New declarations are not duplicates of existing Mathlib/TauCeti material and reuse SSet.homology correctly. But the file is stated over the heavy geometric Geometry.SimplicialComplex 𝕜 E while using only the base PreAbstractSimplicialComplex E interface, failing to reuse the right existing abstraction.
